I rent this 0.90 hectare tuber plot, so I must be careful with spending and focus on what I can manage well with my household. I will use some chemical fertilizer and a little organic manure if I can get it, because tubers need the soil to carry well, but I will not do anything too costly. I will plant improved seed material if available, control weeds with herbicide, and depend on the rains since I do not have irrigation. My family will do much of the work, but I will still hire some labor for land preparation and harvesting.
